reference_sql:
WITH checked_products AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT product_id
  FROM competitor_prices
)
SELECT s.channel, SUM(s.units) AS units
FROM sales s
JOIN checked_products cp ON cp.product_id = s.product_id
GROUP BY s.channel
alternatives: WITH checked_products AS (SELECT product_id FROM competitor_prices GROUP BY product_id) SELECT s.channel, SUM(s.units) AS units FROM sales s JOIN checked_products cp ON cp.product_id = s.product_id GROUP BY 1

WITH product_units AS (SELECT channel, product_id, SUM(units) AS units FROM sales GROUP BY channel, product_id), checked_products AS (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM competitor_prices) SELECT u.channel, SUM(u.units) AS units FROM product_units u JOIN checked_products c ON c.product_id = u.product_id GROUP BY u.channel

other_way.sql: WITH product_units AS (SELECT channel, product_id, SUM(units) AS units FROM sales GROUP BY channel, product_id), checked_products AS (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM competitor_prices) SELECT u.channel, SUM(u.units) AS units FROM product_units u JOIN checked_products c ON c.product_id = u.product_id GROUP BY u.channel
other_way.tradeoff: Adding up units per channel and product before the join also avoids repeats, but the DISTINCT product list is the shorter fix.
